verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street is an immigration-services firm with case workflows and status dashboards, so a public API for driving cases programmatically is a fair question to ask, but the evidence documents none. Probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI/Swagger specs all returned 404. The claim that it plugs into People Ops describes an integration service, not a documented API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
